name: colProds
title: Calculates the product for each column in a matrix

origin.description: Calculates the product for each row (column) in a matrix.
origin.usage:
colProds(x, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, na.rm = FALSE,
  method = c("direct", "expSumLog"), ..., useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An NxK matrix or, if dim. is specified, an N * K vector.

arguments.name: rows, cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of rows (and/or columns) to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, missing values are excluded.

arguments.name: method
arguments.text: A character string specifying how each product is calculated. The first element is used. "direct" multiplies with prod(). "expSumLog" calls product().

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: colProds() calls the same product rules as rowProds() down each column. method = "direct" uses base::prod(). method = "expSumLog" calls product(). An empty column has product 1. The default method is direct.
origin.value: A numeric vector of length K.

translation.description: Calculates the product for each row (column) in a matrix.
translation.usage:
colProds(x, rows=None, cols=None, na_rm=False, method="direct",
          dim=None, use_names=True)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An N by K array, or a one-dimensional vector when dim is given. Axis 0 is rows and axis 1 is columns, matching the printed R matrix. A missing double is NaN.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based rows to include. None uses every row. Zeros are dropped and negative values exclude, as in R.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based columns to include. None uses every column. A positive index past the margin is an error. A positive index below 1 truncates to 0 and is dropped.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If True, missing values are excluded. This is na.rm. An empty product is 1.

arguments.name: method
arguments.text: "direct" multiplies in float64. "expSumLog" calls product() on each column. Only the first string is used, and it must match exactly. The default is direct.

arguments.name: dim
arguments.text: Two integers giving the shape of x, also when x is not a matrix. This is dim. When x is one-dimensional, the values fill that shape in column-major order.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: Accepted for compatibility with useNames. The result is always a plain float64 vector; names are not attached.

translation.details: Each selected column is multiplied directly, or passed to product() when method is expSumLog. direct underflows a long product of uniforms on (0.5, 1.5) to 0. An empty column selection returns a zero-length vector. An empty row selection returns 1 for each selected column.
translation.value: A float64 vector of length K, one product for each selected column.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.rowprods import colProds

x = np.array([[1, 3, 5], [2, 4, 6]], dtype=float)
colProds(x)
